meaning.en: A march for accompanying quick time.

meaning.en: A spirited dance step or a combination of such steps, as in ballroom dancing.

sentences.en: He was ruled out of the next game with a hamstring injury that was, according to Stan, sustained doing the quickstep.

sentences.en: However, many of the dance techniques remained in other forms of dance such as the Foxtrot (danced competitively) and the aptly named Quickstep.
